glosses: A mathematical statement of some importance that has been proven to be true. Minor theorems are often called propositions. Theorems which are not very interesting in themselves but are an essential part of a bigger theorem's proof are called lemmas.

examples.text: Fermat's Last Theorem was known thus long before it was proved in the 1990s.

examples.text: „Das Modigliani-Miller-Theorem besagt, daß die durchschnittlichen Kapitalkosten einer Unternehmung unabhängig vom Verschuldungsgrad immer gleich groß sind.“

examples.text: Antworte im ganzen Satz.
